# GoNoodle

> > GoNoodle provides engaging movement, dance, and mindfulness videos designed to help elementary students stay active, build social-emotional skills, and improve overall wellness.

GoNoodle is a digital platform featuring curated video content including dance-alongs, fitness activities, mindfulness exercises, and social-emotional learning resources for classroom and home use. The platform leverages popular music, branded content partnerships (KIDZ BOP, Nintendo), and expert instructors like Blazer Fresh and Coach Terry to make movement and wellness fun and accessible for elementary-age children.

## Key Topics

- Elementary movement and fitness
- Dance-alongs and choreography
- Mindfulness and relaxation
- Social-emotional learning
- Classroom activities
- Indoor recess
- Music-based fitness
- KIDZ BOP Kids
- Blazer Fresh
- The Mooderators
- Spanish-language content
- Physical activity
- Kids wellness
- Google Classroom integration

## Featured Dance & Movement Videos

- [The Ball Is In Your Court](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/nYMvpX/the-ball-is-in-your-court): Tennis-themed fitness video with Blazer Fresh for elementary kids
- [I Can Do That](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/GYpNq2/i-can-do-that): Dance fitness video with Sloane Stephens and Blazer Fresh
- [Party In The USA](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/9Y7xpX/party-in-the-usa): Guided dance video to Miley Cyrus song via Noodle Television
- [Better When I'm Dancing](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/0YZpG2/better-when-im-dancing): Pop music dance video for elementary movement and wellness
- [Strike A Pose](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/EY9EjY/strike-a-pose): Interactive pose game with GoNoodle Champs for classrooms
- [Indoor Recess: Blazer Fresh 2.0 Edition](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/Y7ldZX/indoor-recess-blazer-fresh-2-dot-0-edition): Indoor recess dance party with Coach Terry and Blazer Fresh
- [Cosmic Power-Up with Mario and Yoshi](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/XddxbX/cosmic-power-up-with-mario-and-yoshi): Nintendo-themed fitness video with Mario and Yoshi characters

## Social-Emotional Learning & Mindfulness

- [The Mooderators: Angry](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/9Y7LpX/the-mooderators-angry): Social-emotional learning video on anger management for kids
- [Every Body HAPPY Together](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/72Ge8Y/every-body-happy-together): Social-emotional learning dance with Matt Maxey for happiness
- [Rest Well](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/eYRk0X/rest-well): Guided mindfulness and sleep wellness video for evening routine
